data.one_liner: Opens system and app settings pages on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to launch various system setting screens such as NFC, power options, app info, and notification settings. On iOS it opens the app's settings page or the Settings home if none are defined.
use_when: You need a quick way to let users adjust system or app settings from your app
You want to direct users to specific Android settings like NFC or power options
avoid_when: You require fine‑grained control over settings beyond what the plugin exposes
You need a cross‑platform solution that also works on web or desktop
strengths: Simple API for common settings pages
weaknesses: iOS can only open the app settings page
